channel.title: GiveOwl – Christmas competitions 2026 (Australia)
channel.description: Christmas competitions and giveaways from Australian promoters for 2026, each checked on the promoter's own page. Many close in late November or early December, so check the closing date on each one. The purchase rule is on each entry; check the promoter's terms.

item.title: MiNDFOOD 30 Days of Christmas: win a True Protein gift pack – MiNDFOOD (McHugh Media Australia Pty Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One True Protein gift pack (A$250). Deadline: November 19, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the MiNDFOOD competition page (name, email, phone, address) and answer «What is your favourite Christmas memory?» in max 25 words; entries are judged. Free, no purchase necessary; Australian residents only. Newsletter tick-boxes are optional. Opens 6 Nov 2026, closes 10pm AEST on 19.11.2026; winners notified by email.

item.title: Haigh's Win a Signature Advent Calendar (1 of 5) – Haigh's Chocolates
item.description: Prize: 1 of 5 Haigh's Signature Advent Calendars (valued at $290 each). Deadline: November 23, 2026. Answer the question in the embedded form on the competition page and tick yes to Haigh's promotional emails. Winners 18+. 12 Oct – 23 Nov 2026 (closes 12:00pm ACDT), draw 23 Nov

item.title: MiNDFOOD 30 Days of Christmas: win Crescent Nest’s All In One Set – MiNDFOOD (McHugh Media Australia Pty Ltd)

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (AU) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: A$1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time)

item.title: The Home And Party Shop: win $1,000 of Christmas lights – The Home And Party Shop
item.description: Prize: A $1,000 store gift card (digital). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter free with name, email and the two entry questions via the website form. No purchase necessary, Australian residents 18+, one entry per person. 15 Sep to 30 Nov 2026, drawn 1 Dec

item.title: VegKit: Nanna's Christmas Hamper Giveaway – Animals Australia Limited (trading as VegKit.com)
item.description: Prize: One 'Nanna's Favourite Things Hamper' with food items and ingredients, kitchen utensils, Nanna's recipe booklet, a Bunnings gift voucher, a pig plush toy and merchandise (up to AU$550 plus up to AU$80 delivery; total up to AU$630). Deadline: December 6, 2026. Submit the entry form on VegKit.com with your name and email (phone optional) and join the VegKit email list (Nanna Diaries emails); you must still be subscribed at the draw. Free, one entry per person. Australian residents 18+. 2 Nov 2026 12:00 am – 6 Dec 2026 11:59 pm AEDT; draw 7 Dec 2026. The hamper contains cooking vermouth, so the winner must verify they are 18+.

item.title: Win The Ultimate Christmas Entertaining Set – The Good Food & Wine Show (Spectapular Enterprises Pty Ltd)
item.description: Prize: salt&pepper homeware pack (over $2,200) + Wine Selectors Chairman's wine subscription (4 × 6 bottles, $1,660); total about $3,882. Deadline: December 9, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Good Food & Wine Show website; multiple entries allowed. 18+, residents of VIC, NSW, SA, QLD, TAS or WA (not NT/ACT). Closes 9 Dec 2026, 11:59pm AEDT

item.title: SALIFE Select and Win for Christmas: choose your prize draw (SA) – Solstice Media (SALIFE)
item.description: Prize: Choose one of several prize draws from South Australian partners (each prize valued about $179–$736). Deadline: December 16, 2026. Subscribe to the free SALIFE newsletter and choose the prize draw you want to enter on the Solstice Media competition page. South Australian residents 18+, no purchase necessary. 2 Nov 2026 09:00 – 16 Dec 2026 12:00

item.title: AmazingCo "Joy, Unwrapped 2026" – AmazingCo
item.description: Prize: 19 prizes worth up to $4,918 in total: 18 gift prizes (6 weekly, 12 daily) plus a grand prize drawn 4 Jan 2027. Deadline: December 24, 2026. Create a free AmazingCo account, stay subscribed to their emails and unwrap each gift while it is live. Australian residents 18+

item.title: HarperCollins Give the Gift of Reading Christmas Giveaway – HarperCollins Publishers Australia
item.description: Prize: 3 book packs, each valued at over AUD 800. Deadline: January 4, 2027. Fill in the entry form on givethegiftofreading.com.au, no purchase necessary. Australian residents 18+ (16+ with parental permission), one entry per household. Closes 9am AEDT on 4 January 2027
